dataset: PlantVillage full multicrop 54,304 images, 38 classes, 14 crops
license: Source project metadata must be reviewed before redistribution; training report flags commercial redistribution licensing review as outstanding.

evaluation.scope: within-source group-isolated holdout; not independent field validation

limitations: PlantVillage-style imagery; no Syrian coastal field validation.
The 38-class model has no Brown Spot, Downy Mildew, Powdery Mildew, or grape mite class.
Per-class recall for grape Black Rot is only 0.627; treat as exploratory.
No disease score is a calibrated probability.
